duration.to: Extended to a one-year moratorium on 2026-07-14; reported to run into June 2027 while the County's advisory committee develops recommendations.
duration.reason: The original 45-day urgency ordinance was superseded by the County's July extension.

duration_days.reason: The public record identifies a one-year extension but not a reliable fixed-day calculation from the original adoption date.

duration_kind.reason: The continuing measure is tied to the advisory/zoning process rather than the original 45-day term.

current_status.from: Board froze all data center project approvals and established a special committee to examine land use and zoning regulations, with findings due in January (2027).
current_status.to: Extended and active as of 2026-08-19. Imperial County's Board extended the initial 45-day emergency pause to a one-year moratorium while the Data Center Advisory Committee evaluates zoning and land-use policy; reporting describes the pause as running into June 2027.
current_status.reason: The July extension displaced the expired original term.

evidence.supports: Establishes the original urgency interim ordinance and advisory committee action.

evidence.title: Imperial County data center moratorium will last one year
evidence.supports: Reports that the Board extended the pause from 45 days to one year.
evidence.quote: The moratorium would apply ... unless it is overturned in court.
